statement: let W := fun (A B : Finset ℕ) (n : ℕ) => ((A ×ˢ B).filter (fun t => t.1+t.2=n)).card; ∀ (m n : ℕ) (A B : Finset ℕ), n < m → (∀ a ∈ A, a < m) → (∀ b ∈ B, b < m) → min ((A.filter (fun a => n < a)).card) ((B.filter (fun b => n < b)).card) < ((A ×ˢ B).filter (fun t => (t.1+t.2)%m=n)).card → 0 < W A B n

plain_statement.zh: 模路径数超过伪命中预算时恢复整数命中
plain_statement.en: Certify an integer hit from a modular surplus

brief.zh: 组合进位分层与高端预算。须另行证明素数集合的模计数超过预算，才能用于一个指定偶数。
brief.en: Combine the carry split and the tail bound. A prime-set application still needs an independent surplus at its target.
